networkPolicy.desc: Navigation works; place photos and Street View do not

notes:
Every host is written out, and that is the whole point of this file. Upstream blocks "*.googleusercontent.com", which reads as a wildcard and is not one: in this data format the star is dropped and a www twin added, so it expands to googleusercontent.com and www.googleusercontent.com and matches nothing that serves a photograph. See KDroidHosts in the application for the evidence.

The numbered families are written out in full, 0 through 9, because the device proved that guessing the range is how photographs get through. A first pass covered lh3 through lh6 and the photographs kept arriving; the log said why:

    lh3.googleusercontent.com -> 0.0.0.0
    gz0.googleusercontent.com -> 216.239.38.135

gz0 was not on the list and was serving them. Listing a range that does not exist yet costs nothing; leaving one out costs the whole rule.

Note that gz0.googleusercontent.com answers on the same address as mobilemaps-pa-gz.googleapis.com, which carries the map itself. That is why this file blocks names and never addresses: the map keeps working, the photographs do not.
